segments.he: רבינו ז"ל השי"ת גדול כ"כ שאפילו מה שהרופא מקלקל השי"ת מתקן דער אייבשטער איז אזוא גבוס אז אפילו וואס דער דאקטר מאכט קאליא קען עד אויך פארכעטין. עוד אמר שאם אעפי"כ הולכין להרופא עכ"פ ילכו להרופא היותר גדול.
segments.en: His son Reb Volf of Baskivitz engaged in business and was a man of means. He wanted to support his father Reb Shmuel — but Reb Shmuel refused, for he never derived benefit from others throughout his life. He walked in simple, plain clothes since he had no means for fine garments. His son suffered from this and rebuked him — that he should make himself proper garments. Reb Shmuel replied as before: he would not derive benefit. Nothing helped — until his son hit upon an argument: that by his poverty his father was actually disgracing and shaming him — for the world does not know it is because he refuses to accept from his son; they will only say it is because his son is a miser who will not clothe his own father. With this argument he persuaded him to accept the garments. After his death they found all the accounts of everything his son had spent on him — itemized so it could be repaid — so that he should not have derived benefit from others.
